text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Fan Fest has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf takes to the specially erected stage to lead the opening ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As I announced several days ago on TV, I have christened this event the academy's first Mega Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At the time, I explained that this represented its increased scale and participation…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But, to tell the truth, there is one more "mega" aspect to this Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Namely, the scale of our gratitude for our fans.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We would not be able to chase our dreams if you did not come to watch us race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We all strive to honor your support with our best performances, but this alone cannot repay our debt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, on behalf of all the Umamusume of Tracen Academy, allow me to express my gratitude to each and every one of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's opening address is a little formal, but her commanding demeanor has the fans listening raptly… to a point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, allow me to bring this address to a close with a spot of comedy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Like a gutter on a stormy day, I am a "grate full."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Murmur… murmur…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is she doing?! There weren't any puns in the script!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Damn it! She's gone rogue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other student council members tense up. And the audience's reaction is…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: H-hey… Th-that was pretty funny… I think?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I didn't really get it… but anything Symboli Rudolf says sounds cool to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience erupts with applause. But as for Symboli Rudolf herself…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That didn't land quite how I'd hoped. This calls for some refinement…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …She seems to be regretting her decision.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? That was a joke? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Wait, a grate full… Grate full… Grateful! I get it! It's a joke!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You know, I keep wondering… Do you think the President secretly likes comedy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I was thinking the same thing! Only, she's so serious, I figured there was no way…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Wait, you two as well?! Then, there's no doubt about it…

text_block_list.name: Trio
text_block_list.text: The President's a pun-lover!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: The Emperor cracking jokes?! I love it!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Gahahaha! Go Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They're all laughing! I knew my secret weapon wouldn't fail me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf's joke sets the crowd on fire! Even if it's not quite in the way she intended.
